items.source: Configure a specific BeanNameGenerator to be used when creating the repository beans.
items.translation: 配置一个特定的BeanNameGenerator，以便在创建存储库 Bean 时使用。

items.source: Configures the name of the MongoTemplate bean to be used with the repositories detected.
items.translation: 配置与检测到的仓库一起使用的MongoTemplatebean的名称。

items.source: Base packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于扫描已注解组件的基础包。

items.source:
Configures whether nested repository-interfaces (e.g. defined as inner classes) should be discovered by the
repositories infrastructure.
items.translation: 配置是否由仓库基础设施发现嵌套的仓库接口（例如定义为内部类的接口）。

items.source: Whether to automatically create indexes for query methods defined in the repository interface.
items.translation: 是否自动为存储库接口中定义的查询方法创建索引。

items.source: Specifies which types are not eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定不适用于组件扫描的类型。

items.source: Configure the repository base class to be used to create repository proxies for this particular configuration.
items.translation: 配置用于为当前特定配置创建存储库代理的存储库基类。

items.source: false by default.
items.translation: 默认值为 false。

items.source: Supports ${…} placeholders which are resolved against the Environment as well as Ant-style package patterns — for example, "org.example.**".
items.translation: 支持 `${…}` 占位符，这些占位符会针对 Environment 进行解析，同时也支持 Ant 风格的包模式——例如 `"org.example.**"`。

items.source: Multiple packages or patterns may be specified, either separately or within a single String — for example, {"org.example.config", "org.example.service.**"} or "org.example.config, org.example.service.**".
items.translation: 可以指定多个包或模式，既可以单独列出，也可以包含在单个 `String` 中——例如 `{"org.example.config", "org.example.service.**"}` 或 `"org.example.config, org.example.service.**"`。

items.source: value() is an alias for (and mutually exclusive with) this attribute.
items.translation: value() 是该属性的别名，且二者互斥。

items.source: Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 使用basePackageClasses()作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Annotation to activate reactive MongoDB repositories. If no base package is configured through either value(), basePackages() or basePackageClasses() it will trigger scanning of the package of annotated class.
items.translation: 用于激活响应式 MongoDB 仓库的注解。如果未通过 value()、basePackages() 或 basePackageClasses() 配置基础包，则将对被注解类的包进行扫描。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute. Allows for more concise annotation declarations e.g.: @EnableReactiveMongoRepositories("org.my.pkg") instead of @EnableReactiveMongoRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg").
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。允许使用更简洁的注解声明，例如： @EnableReactiveMongoRepositories("org.my.pkg")，而不是 @EnableReactiveMongoRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg")。

items.source: Returns the key of the QueryLookupStrategy to be used for lookup queries for query methods. Defaults to QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND.
items.translation: 返回用于查询方法查找查询的 QueryLookupStrategy 的键。默认值为 QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance. Defaults to MongoRepositoryFactoryBean.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。默认值为 MongoRepositoryFactoryBean。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包的安全类型替代方案 basePackages()。

items.source: Returns the key of the QueryLookupStrategy to be used for lookup queries for query methods.
items.translation: 返回用于查询方法的查询查找策略的 QueryLookupStrategy 键。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute.
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components. The package of each class specified will be scanned. Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 这是用于指定要扫描以查找带注解组件的包的 `basePackages()` 的类型安全替代方案。将扫描每个指定类的包。建议在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning. Further narrows the set of candidate components from everything in basePackages() to everything in the base packages that matches the given filter or filters.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型有资格进行组件扫描。进一步将候选组件的范围从basePackages()中所有内容缩小到与给定过滤器或过滤器匹配的基本包中的所有内容。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations. Defaults to Impl. So for a repository named PersonRepository the corresponding implementation class will be looked up scanning for PersonRepositoryImpl.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀，默认为"Impl"。因此，对于名为 `PersonRepository` 的仓库，系统将扫描以查找对应的实现类 `PersonRepositoryImpl`。

items.source: Configures the location of where to find the Spring Data named queries properties file. Will default to META-INF/mongo-named-queries.properties.
items.translation: 配置查找 Spring Data 命名查询属性文件的位置。默认值为 `META-INF/mongo-named-queries.properties`。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型符合组件扫描条件。

items.source: Configures the location of where to find the Spring Data named queries properties file.
items.translation: 配置查找 Spring Data 命名查询属性文件的位置。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀。

items.source: the BeanNameGenerator to be used or the base BeanNameGenerator interface to indicate context default.
items.translation: 使用BeanNameGenerator或基础BeanNameGenerator接口以指示上下文默认值。

items.source: empty String by default.
items.translation: 默认为空String。

items.source: QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下为QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND。

items.source: ReactiveMongoRepositoryFactoryBean by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下使用 ReactiveMongoRepositoryFactoryBean。

items.source: DefaultRepositoryBaseClass by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下为DefaultRepositoryBaseClass。

items.source: Mark Paluch
items.translation: 马克·帕卢赫

items.translation: 默认情况下使用 reactiveMongoTemplate。
